title: サマースプリントシリーズ始まる！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, Director Akikawa makes a sudden announcement about the Summer Sprint Series.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She says something good might happen if Curren can place well in the Summer Sprints. Considering her schedule, I suggest three races…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Hakodate Sprint Stakes in late June, the Keeneland Cup in late August, and the Centaur Stakes in late September.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It isn't mandatory, so Curren Chan says that it's up to me whether we take them on. Looks like I have some thinking to do…
